cases.purpose: fold -w 5 with its stdout on a pipe and a pipe producer held open: after 'abcdefghijkl\n' the three completed folded lines are delivered, after 'mnopqrs' (no newline) the completed 'mnopq' line is delivered and 'rs' is held; 'rs' arrives only after the producer closes.
cases.oracle: docs/fold.md: 'Completed output flushes before a blocking refill, including output to a pipe, so short complete lines no longer wait for unrelated input or EOF.' GNU fold fully buffers pipe output, so this is a contract.
cases.comparison: contract: exact bytes delivered after each chunk (process blocked and output quiet) and after EOF

cases.purpose: fold -w 5 reading a pipe producer held open and writing to a private pty: the bytes delivered after each chunk and after the producer closes match GNU fold, which line-buffers terminal output.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils fold 9.7 (reference PATH) on the same feeder; docs/fold.md terminal newline flushing.
cases.comparison: byte parity vs GNU fold of each delivery phase (chunk1, chunk2, final) and the feeder status
